source.title_on_document: AHAlogy: Agent-Supported In-Class Analogical Learning for Primary School Students' Divergent Thinking

paper_design_summary: A five-day between-subjects classroom study reported N = 38 elementary school students aged 7 to 11, comparing an analogical STEAM curriculum alone (Control) with the curriculum plus the AHAlogy LLM agent (Experimental). The abstract reports changes in STEAM knowledge, self-reported confidence, and divergent thinking (fluency, flexibility, originality). Assignment methods, analyzed counts, assessment timing, scoring procedures, and AI availability during assessment are not stated in the abstract.
